title.narrative: Building Disaster Resilient Communities in Pokhara and Terai Region

description.narrative: This activity Building Disaster Resilient Communities in Pokhara and Terai Region is a component of UK Support to Increase Resilience to Natural Disasters in Nepal reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £3,174,408. It works in the following sector(s): Disaster prevention and preparedness, Environmental policy and administrative management, Material relief assistance and services.
